lifecycle_decomp.summary_n_counts: HTTP request / lifecycle cycle within one deployment; per-deployment summaries expose n≈30 measured cycles after warmup
lifecycle_decomp.independent_unit: Docker deployment (one container). Article multiband design: 8 profiles × ≥5 independent deployments × 30 measured cycles
lifecycle_decomp.p95_on_summary_n: point estimate of within-deployment cycles only; for profile-level inference summarize deployment medians (n_independent≈5)
lifecycle_decomp.figure_dispersion: within-deployment cycle boxplots are descriptive; profile comparisons use the distribution of the five deployment medians

unified_coldstart.independent_unit: Docker container destroyed after each run
unified_coldstart.p95_on_summary_n: point estimate over ~30 independent starts; no CI

container_concurrency.p95_on_summary_n: grant_batch_latency_p95_ms is a within-run batch p95, then summarized across repeats; legacy grant_latency_p95_ms is amortized, not per-Grant
container_concurrency.figure_dispersion: summary CI95 is for the mean across repeats (n≈5)

tls_mtls_overhead.note: within a persistent block, requests share one TLS connection; block-level medians/p95 are the right inputs to cross-block summaries. Endpoint is GET /ready (transport), not a CBSD-SAS operation.
tls_mtls_overhead.p95_on_summary_n: summary metric latency_p95_ms is the p95 of per-block latency medians/p95s
tls_mtls_overhead.figure_dispersion: boxplot; request-level panels are descriptive, not independent n

persistence_modes.summary_n_counts: randomized block cell (mode × population within repeat)
persistence_modes.independent_unit: randomized block (repeat); 6 treatments ordered within each block
persistence_modes.note: group by persist_mode × devices (never a missing 'mode' column). Paired mode comparisons must stay within the same repeat/block.
persistence_modes.figure_dispersion: boxplot over repeats; persistence_wall_median bars show medians without error bars

factorial_provisioning.summary_n_counts: cell observation inside a randomized block (configs A–D)
factorial_provisioning.independent_unit: randomized complete block (repeat) with four treatments
factorial_provisioning.note: Primary inference: blocked log-contrasts across complete repeats. CRD two-way ANOVA that ignores blocks is supplementary only.
factorial_provisioning.p95_on_summary_n: probe_grant_p95_ms is within-run probe p95 if present
factorial_provisioning.figure_dispersion: tables use median/IQR over repeats; effects use block contrasts

process_concurrency.p95_on_summary_n: within-run latency p95 summarized across repeats
process_concurrency.figure_dispersion: CI95 for mean across n=5 repeats when reported

sustained_mixed_load.note: txfix schedule (respect_transmit_expire) is the article-relevant corpus

figure_conventions.boxplots: IQR box, whiskers and fliers; not a confidence interval. The plotted sample is whatever unit the CSV row represents.
figure_conventions.persistence_wall_median: Grouped bars of medians only — no error bars / no CI.

prior_corrections.P0-02: grant_latency_p95_ms is amortized, not per-Grant p95
prior_corrections.P0-04: pre-fix cold-start decompositions are not reusable as-is
prior_corrections.P1-07: fixed_total vs fixed_per_agent must not be pooled
prior_corrections.P1-09: illustrative limits must not be tuned after seeing calibration

k_selection_sensitivity.reason: No calibration campaign with fixed population and measured memory/latency under the P1-09 limits is present in artifacts. Sensitivity of selected K cannot be assessed from current data.
k_selection_sensitivity.minimal_collection: Run container_concurrency with --devices 1500, K∈{1,2,3,5,10,15}, 5 repeats (calibration), then 5 validation repeats for selected K and reference K=15 with a disjoint seed (see P1-09).

container_concurrency.recommendation: With n_repeats=5, mean CIs are wide; do not treat run-level p95 as a stable tail proof. Prefer median/IQR of load_wall_sec and grant_batch_latency_p95_ms across repeats.
